title: Woman Relaxing in Armchair, 1955 B&W Indoor Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black and white snapshot stamped October 1955, depicting a woman named Maxine lounging comfortably in an upholstered armchair with her feet propped up. She wears a sleeveless white blouse and dark pants, emblematic of mid-20th-century casual fashion. The living room features a fireplace mantle decorated with flowers, an oval wall frame, and a floor standing ashtray, offering an authentic glimpse into post-war American domestic life.
